name: Arcane Archer

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: A fighter who infuses ammunition with magic. Some features are reference-only; see each feature’s implementation status.

feature.name: Arcane Archer Lore: Cantrip
feature.summary: Learn Druidcraft or Prestidigitation using Intelligence.
feature.text: Learn Druidcraft or Prestidigitation using Intelligence.

feature.name: Arcane Archer Lore: Skills
feature.summary: Gain Arcana and Nature proficiency, replacing each already-known skill with a Fighter starting skill. This conditional proficiency grant is reference-only.
feature.text: Gain Arcana and Nature proficiency, replacing each already-known skill with a Fighter starting skill. This conditional proficiency grant is reference-only.

feature.name: Arcane Shot
feature.summary: Choose two Arcane Shot options. Learn one more at Fighter levels 7, 10, 15, and 18; each time, you may replace a known option. Once per turn apply one option to a ranged Ammunition-weapon attack, after hitting and dealing damage unless the option replaces the roll. Uses equal Intelligence modifier (minimum 1), restored on Short or Long Rest. Save DC 8 + Intelligence modifier + PB. Arcane Shot die: d6, d8 at Fighter 10, d10 at 15, d12 at 18. Shot selection and effects are reference-only; see the source for the eight options.

feature.name: Curving Shot
feature.summary: Immediately after missing with a ranged Ammunition-weapon attack, a Bonus Action redirects it toward a visible creature within weapon range and 60 feet of the original target. Make a new attack roll.
feature.text: Immediately after missing with a ranged Ammunition-weapon attack, a Bonus Action redirects it toward a visible creature within weapon range and 60 feet of the original target. Make a new attack roll.

feature.name: Magical Ammunition
feature.summary: Magic action: shoot nonmagical ammunition at a visible solid surface in weapon range. Choose shadows (15-foot Emanation for 1 minute; extinguish nonmagical flames, −5 Perception and Passive Perception), unlocking (15-foot Emanation; unbar/unstick or open one nonmagical lock per object; sound audible 300 feet), or a climbable 120-foot vine for 10 minutes. Removing it with a Magic action ends the effect; ammunition is destroyed when the effect ends. Once per Short or Long Rest; spend Second Wind freely to restore use.

feature.name: Ever-Ready Shot
feature.summary: Regain one Arcane Shot use on rolling Initiative.

feature.name: Indomitable Teleport
feature.summary: After succeeding on an Indomitable save, teleport up to 60 feet to an empty visible space.

feature.name: Masterful Shots
feature.summary: Reaction when a visible creature misses you: move up to half Speed away without Opportunity Attacks, then make a ranged attack against it if within weapon range.
